output: {"answers":{"v02":"A search for 'jaguar' returns 10 results, 6 about the animal (relevant), and 8 relevant documents exist in total. Precision answers: of what we returned, how much is useful? 6/10 = 60%. Recall answers: of everything useful, how much did we find? 6/8 = 75%. They punish different failures: low precision means junk in the list; low recall means missed documents. The two trade off. Add looser keywords: you pull in the 2 missing relevant docs (recall 8/8) but also junk, and precision may drop to 50%. Which matters more depends on cost — a legal discovery search favors recall; a one-box answer favors precision. Identification rule: precision is counted over what was returned, recall over everything that exists.","v07":"公共物品有两个特征：多用一份不增加成本（非竞争），也没法把不付钱的人排除在外（非排他）。小区路灯是典型：一盏灯照亮所有路人，你无法只给交钱的人照明。于是出现搭便车：每家都想「别人出钱，我照样享受」，付费意愿被藏起来，结果是路灯本可让大家受益，却谁都不装。这不是道德滑坡，而是结构问题：好处无法独占时市场供给不足，所以路灯、国防通常靠税收和政府提供。判断方法是拿到任何物品先问两句——能收费排除吗？多用一份要多花钱吗？条件变化：一旦变得可排他，比如改成刷卡才能进的小区门禁，它就变成可收费的物品，搭便车问题随之消失。","v05":"信息熵衡量「看到结果之前有多难猜」。公式 H = −Σ p·log₂p：把每种结果的概率 p 换成 −p·log₂p 再求和，单位是比特。公平硬币：0.5×1+0.5×1=1 比特；两面都是正面：0 比特，毫无悬念。均匀概率最不确定，是因为猜对没有可乘之机——每种结果可能性相同，你对「会出哪面」一无所知，怎么押胜率都一样。一旦概率偏斜，比如 90% 正面，熵降到约 0.47 比特：你总猜正面，十次对九次，不确定性小了。所以熵说的是：概率分布越把质量集中在一处，越可预测；摊得越平，越难押中。条件变化：把 90/10 逐渐挪向 50/50，熵单调上升，在均匀处达到最大值 log₂(结果数)。","d07":"冰淇淋销量与溺水人数同涨同跌，但吃冰淇淋不会淹死人——两者都由夏季高温驱动。「一起变化」叫相关；「A 导致 B」是因果，需要 A 的改变真的引起 B 的改变。混淆常来自三种情况：共同原因（高温同时推高两者）、反向因果（B 才是源头）、纯属巧合（样本太少）。判断依据是问一句：如果禁止卖冰淇淋，溺水会减少吗？不会，因为真正的开关是气温。条件变化：只看夏天数据，正相关很强；把冬天数据也放进来，相关明显减弱——混杂因素被部分控制了。要确立因果，必须只动 A 而不动其他，比如随机对照实验；观察数据里的相关，最多算线索。","d04":"You have one free afternoon and can pick only one: nap, study, or take a paid shift worth $50. Whatever you choose, its opportunity cost is the value of the single best option you gave up — not all the others added together. If you nap, the cost is $50, since the shift beats studying for you today. If you take the shift, the cost is the rest you wanted most. This is why 'free' time isn't free: an afternoon spent is one of your finite afternoons spent. Two clarifications: cost is measured by the runner-up only, and it's subjective — a burned-out person's cost of working is high. If the paid gig disappears, napping suddenly costs almost nothing. Every 'choose this' silently means 'give up the second-best'.","v04":"An operation is idempotent when doing it once and doing it five times leave the system in the same final state. 'Set order status to paid' is idempotent; 'add $10 to the balance' is not — five calls add $50. Distributed systems need this because networks lose responses: the server may have succeeded, but the client never got the confirmation and will retry. Without idempotency, every retry risks a double charge. The standard fix is an idempotency key: the client attaches a unique ID per operation, the server remembers processed IDs, and a retried request returns the stored result instead of executing again. Identification rule: is applying it twice a no-op the second time? GET, PUT-by-ID, and DELETE are naturally idempotent; plain POST increments are not.","d05":"某病患病率千分之一。检测手段：病人 99% 呈阳性，健康人也有 5% 假阳性。你查出阳性，真患病的概率是多少？直觉说 99%，但要用贝叶斯公式把两类人数都算上。设想 10 万人：约 100 人有病，其中 99 人阳性；其余 99900 人健康，5% 即约 4995 人假阳性。阳性共约 5094 人，真正有病的只占 99/5094 ≈ 1.9%。公式正是 P(患病|阳性) = P(阳性|患病)×P(患病) ÷ P(阳性)：分子是「有病且检出」，分母是「所有检出阳性的人」。这么低的原因是健康人基数太大，假阳性的绝对数压倒了真阳性。条件变化：复检一次，先验换成 1.9%，再得阳性会把概率推到约 28%——上一轮的后验就是下一轮的先验，信息逐轮累积。","d06":"A cache keeps a copy of expensive data — say a product page built from the database — so repeat requests are fast. Invalidation is the problem of keeping that copy consistent with the source: the store lowers the price, but the cache still serves the old page, and customers see a stale price. Standard moves: expire by time (TTL) — accept staleness for at most, say, 60 seconds; invalidate on write — when the price changes, delete the cached entry so the next request rebuilds it. Each trades something: TTL is simple but can show wrong prices for a while; write-invalidation is fresher but couples the cache to every write path. It's famously hard because you must know exactly which stored copies, across many servers, a single underlying change makes wrong.","v08":"Little's law: L = λW. L is the average number of items in the system, λ the average arrival rate, W the average time each item spends in the system. At a coffee shop, 30 customers arrive per hour and each stays 10 minutes (1/6 hour), so on average L = 30 × 1/6 = 5 people inside. The law is a conservation statement: if arrivals speed up or people linger longer, the population grows in proportion. Its power: any two quantities determine the third, so you can measure throughput and duration and infer occupancy without counting. It assumes steady state — averages stable over time, no overflow. Test it: cut wait time in half while arrivals stay constant and the queue halves, from 5 to 2.5. The same formula covers tickets in a backlog or requests in a server queue.","v06":"Two threads each need two locks. Thread A takes Lock 1, thread B takes Lock 2, then A asks for Lock 2 and B asks for Lock 1. Each waits forever for the other to let go: that is deadlock. Four conditions must hold at once — resources are exclusively held, holders keep them while waiting (hold-and-wait), nothing can be forcibly taken away (no preemption), and the waits form a circle. Break any one and deadlock becomes impossible; the cheapest break is the circle. If both threads acquire locks in the same global order (always Lock 1, then Lock 2), B can never hold what A needs while needing what A holds. Database and OS tools literally build resource-allocation graphs and check for such cycles to detect or prevent this state.","d02":"平均数只说「中心在哪」，不说「散得多开」。两个班平均分都是 70：一个班 65–75，一个班 40–100，平均数看不出差别，方差就是补上这一点的量。做法：算每个数与平均数的差，平方后取平均。例：数据 2、4、6，平均 4，偏差是 −2、0、2，平方得 4、0、4，方差 = (4+0+4)/3 = 8/3 ≈ 2.67。为什么平方？偏差直接相加正负抵消成零；平方让每个差距都算正数，还放大离群点——差得越远，惩罚增长越快。代价是单位变成「分的平方」，所以日常报告的是它的平方根（标准差），单位回到「分」。条件变化：把 6 换成 20，平均数被拉到约 8.7，方差暴涨到约 65——方差对远离中心的点极其敏感。","v03":"自然选择不是动物「努力变强、再把能力传给后代」，而是环境对已有差异做筛选。喷洒杀虫剂前，虫群里本来就随机存在少量抗药变异——不是为对付农药而产生的，碰巧而已。药一喷，普通个体大量死亡，抗药个体存活并留下更多后代。下一代群体里，抗性比例从千分之一升到一半以上：变异是随机的，选择是有方向的。这里没有任何个体在「进步」，单只虫子的基因终生不变，变的是群体里各基因的占比。条件变化：停用农药后，维持抗性的代谢成本更高，没有药时抗药个体反而吃亏，抗性比例可能慢慢回落。判断要点：看到「某物种为了生存而进化出某特征」这类说法就要警惕——进化的单位是种群，机制是差异繁殖，不是意愿。","d03":"正反馈指输出的结果反过来加强输入，使变化沿原方向越滚越大。麦克风对准音箱：声音被拾音、放大、放出去、再被拾到，几秒内变成刺耳啸叫。市场恐慌同理：价格跌 → 触发抛售 → 价格更跌 → 更多人抛。机制核心是一个环：每绕一圈，偏差被乘上一个大于 1 的系数，于是指数式增长或崩塌，直到某个硬限制（音响功率上限、卖无可卖）把环掐断。注意「正」是方向词，不是评价词：它只说明反馈与变化同向，不说明结果好坏——复利是正反馈，恐慌崩盘也是。与之相对，负反馈把偏差往回拉，起稳定作用，比如空调恒温。识别方法：看到「越……就越……」的句式，就找到了正反馈的环。","d08":"Compound growth means each period's gain is added to the base before the next multiplication: A = P(1+r)^t. $1,000 growing at 10% a year becomes $2,594 in ten years, not $2,000 — year two earns interest on year one's interest. Why the starting amount matters: the rate multiplies whatever base you have, so $2,000 under identical conditions becomes $5,188 — exactly double the outcome. Same percentage, yet the absolute gap between the two accounts widens every year, from $1,000 to $2,594. Growth is proportional, so an early advantage compounds into a large one. Time acts similarly: at 10%, money doubles roughly every 7 years (rule of 72: 72 ÷ rate ≈ doubling time). Change the condition: raise r from 10% to 15% and the ten-year factor jumps from 2.59 to 4.05 — small rate differences matter enormously over long horizons.","d01":"同一个数字 P(数据|假设)，问的方向不同，名字就不同。抛一枚硬币 10 次出 7 次正面：若问「假设硬币公平，出现这个结果的概率是多少」，这是似然，答案 C(10,7)(1/2)^10 ≈ 0.117。若问「看到这个结果后，硬币公平的概率是多少」，这是后验概率。两者相差一次方向翻转：似然固定假设看数据，后验固定数据评假设。联系是一条公式：后验 ∝ 似然 × 先验，先验是看数据前你对各假设的信心。似然只说哪个假设最能解释数据，不单独决定该信哪个——若「双面都是正面」的似然更高，但先验极低，后验仍可能偏向公平硬币。所以看到 P(A|B) 别急着解读，先确认条件在哪一边。","v01":"过拟合就是「死记硬背」：模型把训练题目连答案带噪音全部记住，而不是学到规律。好比学生把练习册每道题的答案背下来，练习册上 100 分，考试换个数字就不会做——模型也一样，训练数据上表现极好，遇到新数据错误率猛增。怎么认出来？训练误差很低、新数据误差明显更高，这个落差就是标志。机制上，模型太复杂或数据太少时，它有足够容量把数据里的偶然波动也拟合进去，而这些波动在新数据里并不重现。条件变化：数据量增大，偶然模式难以普遍成立，过拟合自然减轻；换更简单的模型，它想记噪音也记不下。类比有失效处：学生发现背错了会主动改，模型不会自己区分规律与噪音，必须靠你用没见过的新数据从外面检验。"}
